mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT msg.SEQNO AS msgid, CASE WHEN KIND IN ('S','M') THEN 'PH' ELSE BIZTYPE END AS messagetype, msg.MSG AS msg, msg.MSG AS msgsms, msg.CALLPHONE AS phn, msg.REQPHONE AS smssender, CASE WHEN KIND IN ('S','M') THEN KIND ELSE '' END AS smskind, msg.REQTIME AS reservedt, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS regdt, msg.SUBJECT AS smslmstit, msg.YELLOWID_KEY AS profile, msg.TEMPLATECODE AS tmplid, msg.BUTTON_URL AS button, con.FILEPATH1 AS filepath1, con.FILEPATH2 AS filepath2, con.FILEPATH3 AS filepath3 FROM ${msg_table} msg LEFT OUTER JOIN ${con_table} con ON msg.FKCONTENT = con.SEQNO WHERE msg.RESULT = '0' AND msg.KIND = #{msg_type} AND ( msg.REQTIME IS NULL OR msg.REQTIME = '00000000000000' OR msg.REQTIME <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') ) ORDER BY msg.SEQNO ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 200
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${log_table} SELECT * FROM ${msg_table} WHERE SEQNO = #{msgid}
mapper.update: CREATE TABLE ${logTable} AS SELECT * FROM ${msgTable} WHERE 1 = 2
